verses.text: Of David. The LORD is my light and the one who saves me. Who should I be afraid of? The LORD is the strong place where my life is safe. Who should I fear?
When evil people attacked me to eat me up, those enemies and attackers tripped and fell.
Even if an army surrounds me, my heart will not be afraid. Even if war breaks out against me, I will still be confident.
I have asked one thing from the LORD, and this is what I want: to live in the LORD's house all the days of my life, to look at the LORD's beauty and to seek him in his temple.
When trouble comes, he will keep me safe in his shelter. He will hide me in his holy tent. He will set me high on a rock.
Then my head will be held high above my enemies who surround me. I will offer sacrifices in his tent with shouts of joy. I will sing and make music to the LORD.
LORD, hear me when I call out loud. Be kind to me and answer me.
When you said, "Look for my face," my heart said to you, "LORD, I will look for your face."
Do not hide your face from me. Do not turn me, your servant, away in anger. You have been my helper. Do not reject me or leave me, God my saviour.
Even if my father and mother leave me, the LORD will take care of me.
LORD, teach me your way. Lead me on a straight path because of my enemies.
Do not hand me over to what my enemies want, because liars rise up against me and breathe out violence.
I am still sure of this: I will see the LORD's goodness while I am still alive.
Wait for the LORD. Be strong and brave. Yes, wait for the LORD.
